gold_axioms.subject: Action
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Action is named in both CQs and is the range of action.

gold_axioms.subject: Asset
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Asset is named in both CQs.

gold_axioms.subject: AssetCollection
gold_axioms.missing_elements: AssetCollection is the container that CQ30 asks about.

gold_axioms.subject: AssetCollection
gold_axioms.missing_elements: target points to Asset. This axiom lets a collection be the target of a policy.

gold_axioms.subject: ConflictTerm
gold_axioms.missing_elements: ConflictTerm is the strategy returned by conflict.

gold_axioms.subject: Constraint
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Constraint is named in these CQs or lies on their path from a rule to an operator.

gold_axioms.subject: Duty
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Duty is named in these CQs or is their answer.

gold_axioms.subject: Duty
gold_axioms.missing_elements: assignee, assigner, function and constraint have the domain Policy or Rule. Duty reaches them only through this axiom.

gold_axioms.subject: LeftOperand
gold_axioms.missing_elements: LeftOperand is the range of leftOperand used to build a condition.

gold_axioms.subject: LogicalConstraint
gold_axioms.missing_elements: LogicalConstraint is the subject of and, or, xone and operand.

gold_axioms.subject: Operator
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Operator is the range of operator.

gold_axioms.subject: Party
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Party is the range of assignee, assigner and function.

gold_axioms.subject: Permission
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Permission is named in these CQs.

gold_axioms.subject: Permission
gold_axioms.missing_elements: action, assignee, assigner, function and constraint have the domain Policy or Rule. Permission reaches them only through this axiom.

gold_axioms.subject: Policy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Policy is named in these CQs or is the domain of permission, prohibition or obligation that they use.

gold_axioms.subject: Prohibition
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Prohibition is named in these CQs.

gold_axioms.subject: Prohibition
gold_axioms.missing_elements: constraint, assignee and assigner have the domain Policy or Rule. Prohibition reaches them only through this axiom.

gold_axioms.subject: Rule
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Rule is the domain of failure and the parent that gives permissions, duties and prohibitions their properties.

gold_axioms.subject: Only One
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Only One is the xor asked by CQ14.

gold_axioms.subject: Only One
gold_axioms.missing_elements: operand is an explicit property of CQ14. This axiom makes xor a kind of operand.

gold_axioms.subject: action
gold_axioms.missing_elements: action links a permission to its action.

gold_axioms.subject: action
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the permission through its parent Rule.

gold_axioms.subject: action
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is an Action.

gold_axioms.subject: and
gold_axioms.missing_elements: and is asked by CQ14.

gold_axioms.subject: and
gold_axioms.missing_elements: operand is an explicit property of CQ14. This axiom makes and a kind of operand.

gold_axioms.subject: andSequence
gold_axioms.missing_elements: andSequence is the sequencing construct asked by CQ31.

gold_axioms.subject: andSequence
gold_axioms.missing_elements: andSequence alone answers CQ31. operand is not in its annotation.

gold_axioms.subject: assignee
gold_axioms.missing_elements: assignee is one of the party roles.

gold_axioms.subject: assignee
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the permission or duty through its parent Rule.

gold_axioms.subject: assignee
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The role is played by a Party.

gold_axioms.subject: assignee
gold_axioms.missing_elements: function is in the annotation of both CQs. This axiom makes assignee one of the party roles.

gold_axioms.subject: assigner
gold_axioms.missing_elements: assigner is one of the party roles.

gold_axioms.subject: assigner
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the permission or duty through its parent Rule.

gold_axioms.subject: assigner
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The role is played by a Party.

gold_axioms.subject: assigner
gold_axioms.missing_elements: function is in the annotation of both CQs. This axiom makes assigner one of the party roles.

gold_axioms.subject: conflict
gold_axioms.missing_elements: conflict is the property behind handlePolicyConflicts.

gold_axioms.subject: conflict
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the given policy.

gold_axioms.subject: conflict
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The strategy is a ConflictTerm.

gold_axioms.subject: consequence
gold_axioms.missing_elements: consequence is named in CQ31 and CQNew5. It is also a kind of failure for CQNew4.

gold_axioms.subject: consequence
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the given duty.

gold_axioms.subject: consequence
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The consequence is a Duty.

gold_axioms.subject: consequence
gold_axioms.missing_elements: A consequence is a rule activated on failure. CQNew4 needs this axiom to return it through failure.

gold_axioms.subject: constraint
gold_axioms.missing_elements: constraint attaches constraints to rules and policies.

gold_axioms.subject: constraint
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the rule or policy that carries the constraint.

gold_axioms.subject: constraint
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is a Constraint or a LogicalConstraint. CQ13 needs the LogicalConstraint part for nesting.

gold_axioms.subject: duty
gold_axioms.missing_elements: duty is the hasduty property of CQ10.

gold_axioms.subject: duty
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Links a permission to the duties attached to it.

gold_axioms.subject: duty
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is a Duty.

gold_axioms.subject: failure
gold_axioms.missing_elements: failure is the explicit property of CQNew4.

gold_axioms.subject: failure
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the rule that failed.

gold_axioms.subject: failure
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The activated rule is the answer.

gold_axioms.subject: function
gold_axioms.missing_elements: function is the general party role.

gold_axioms.subject: function
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the permission or duty through its parent Rule.

gold_axioms.subject: function
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The role is played by a Party.

gold_axioms.subject: hasPolicy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: hasPolicy is the targetPolicy property of CQNew1.

gold_axioms.subject: hasPolicy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the given asset.

gold_axioms.subject: hasPolicy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The linked policy is the answer.

gold_axioms.subject: implies
gold_axioms.missing_elements: implies relates one action to another.

gold_axioms.subject: implies
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the action of the permission.

gold_axioms.subject: implies
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The other action is the answer.

gold_axioms.subject: inheritFrom
gold_axioms.missing_elements: inheritFrom expresses inheritance between policies.

gold_axioms.subject: inheritFrom
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the child policy.

gold_axioms.subject: inheritFrom
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The parent is a Policy.

gold_axioms.subject: leftOperand
gold_axioms.missing_elements: leftOperand gives the left side of a condition.

gold_axioms.subject: leftOperand
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the constraint.

gold_axioms.subject: leftOperand
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is a LeftOperand.

gold_axioms.subject: obligation
gold_axioms.missing_elements: obligation links a policy to its duties.

gold_axioms.subject: obligation
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the policy.

gold_axioms.subject: obligation
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is a Duty.

gold_axioms.subject: operand
gold_axioms.missing_elements: operand links a logical constraint to its parts.

gold_axioms.subject: operand
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Nested and combined constraints start from a LogicalConstraint.

gold_axioms.subject: operator
gold_axioms.missing_elements: operator gives the operator of a constraint.

gold_axioms.subject: operator
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the constraint.

gold_axioms.subject: operator
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is an Operator.

gold_axioms.subject: or
gold_axioms.missing_elements: or is asked by CQ14.

gold_axioms.subject: or
gold_axioms.missing_elements: operand is an explicit property of CQ14. This axiom makes or a kind of operand.

gold_axioms.subject: partOf
gold_axioms.missing_elements: partOf links an asset to its collection.

gold_axioms.subject: partOf
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the asset inside a collection.

gold_axioms.subject: partOf
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The container is an AssetCollection.

gold_axioms.subject: permission
gold_axioms.missing_elements: permission is the hasPermission property of these CQs.

gold_axioms.subject: permission
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the policy.

gold_axioms.subject: permission
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is a Permission.

gold_axioms.subject: prohibition
gold_axioms.missing_elements: prohibition is the hasProhibition property of these CQs.

gold_axioms.subject: prohibition
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the policy.

gold_axioms.subject: prohibition
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is a Prohibition.

gold_axioms.subject: relation
gold_axioms.missing_elements: relation is in the annotation of CQ30 and is the parent of target.

gold_axioms.subject: relation
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the policy or rule.

gold_axioms.subject: relation
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The value is an Asset.

gold_axioms.subject: remedy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: remedy is named in CQNew3. It is also a kind of failure for CQNew4.

gold_axioms.subject: remedy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the given prohibition.

gold_axioms.subject: remedy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The remedy is a Duty.

gold_axioms.subject: remedy
gold_axioms.missing_elements: A remedy is a rule activated on failure. CQNew4 needs this axiom to return it through failure.

gold_axioms.subject: target
gold_axioms.missing_elements: target links a policy or rule to its asset.

gold_axioms.subject: target
gold_axioms.missing_elements: Starts from the policy or rule.

gold_axioms.subject: target
gold_axioms.missing_elements: The target is an Asset or a collection of assets.

gold_axioms.subject: target
gold_axioms.missing_elements: relation is an explicit property of CQ30. This axiom makes target a kind of relation.
